passive.name: The Darkin Scythe
passive.text: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin.Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions.Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

spells.name: Reaping Slash
spells.text: Kayn dashes, then slashes. Both deal damage.

spells.name: Blade's Reach
spells.text: Kayn damages and slows targets in a line.

spells.name: Umbral Trespass
spells.text: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.

damage.value: Kayn’s blue form deals burst damage, while his red form deals high percentage damage with sustain.

archetype.value: Kayn’s blue form plays as a mobile burst assassin, while his red form plays as a sustaining bruiser.

winCondition.value: Kayn wins by choosing the form and build that fit the matchup.

spikes.why: Kayn gains greater value from Hubris because of his lethality scaling.
Kayn gains bonus damage early in combat with enemy champions.

bait.why: Kayn cannot use Reaping Slash to dash and slash again until its cooldown ends.
Kayn cannot use Shadow Step to walk through terrain again until its cooldown ends.
Kayn cannot use Umbral Trespass to hide in an enemy's body and burst out for massive damage again until its cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Kayn players can undermine his versatility by choosing the wrong form or build.
Choosing the wrong form or build limits Kayn’s versatility.
